description: This Dart source file defines the `ReportRepository` class, which provides high-level data querying methods for financial reports in a Flutter app. It interacts with an SQLite database via the `sqflite` package and performs SQL queries to generate various summaries such as totals within ranges, category breakdowns, weekly and monthly trends, and quick totals, primarily for reporting and analytics purposes.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to generate various financial reports and summaries by executing SQL queries on the local SQLite database. Implements singleton pattern for global access.

methods.name: totalsInRange
methods.description: Returns total income and expenses within a specified date range by executing a SQL query that joins transactions and categories tables and sums amounts based on category type.

methods.name: categoryBreakdown
methods.description: Provides a breakdown of spending or income by category within a date range, returning a list of categories with their respective total amounts.

methods.name: weeklyTrend
methods.description: Generates weekly aggregated data points over a date range, computing income and expense sums per week, with weeks bucketed starting on Monday (ISO weeks).

methods.name: monthlySummary
methods.description: Produces monthly summaries of income and expenses over a date range, with one record per month.

methods.name: quickTotals
methods.description: Returns a simple map of total income, total expense, and net (income minus expense) over a specified date range for quick KPI calculations.
